name: Verhati Rajar
source:
"Ironic. Or rather, maybe... fated?"

Joining the Studio amidst a scandal concerning a disappearing actor, Rajar has masterfully evaded the press ever since. Who is he? What is his goal? But more importantly, why does he know so much about you?

[From [url=https://herchoicevn.tumblr.com/verhati-rajar]official bio[/url]]
